messages:
elena: Draft uploaded: https://drive.redwood/launch/post-v1

elena: Quick sync needed today - please review copy for: 1) headline one-liner, 2) benchmark claim wording + footnote, 3) CTA set for hero + footer, 4) inbound routing for webinar vs demo. Need decisions by 5pm PT. :memo:

rob: Reviewing. Are the benchmark figures from Dedicated on H100S or a different cluster? we should specify hardware and quantization state in the footnote.

elena: Good call. Test runs were on Dedicated (H100S, mixed-precision int8 path) during Apr 2026 alpha. I'll add those details to the methodology note.

cassie: Legal quick-pass: avoid standalone ratios without context. Recommend: "up to 4x in internal performance benchmarks (see methodology)" and include measurement window + baseline definition. Also please don't say "save" or "guarantee".

elena: Updated wording to cassie's suggestion and added measurement dates (Apr 5-12, 2026) and baseline = "fp16 reference serving with continuous batching".

jorge: Growth ops: CTA proposals
- Hero primary: "Book a live demo"
- Hero secondary: "View benchmark details"
- Footer: "Request a trial"
Routing plan: webinar sign-ups -> marketing nurture; demo -> SDR routing; trial -> product ops onboarding. For EMEA hours route to EMEA SDR 08:00-18:00 CET, otherwise fall back to NA SDR.

jorge: Pasted demo-routing CSV for ops handoff (incl owner tags):
```
region,segment,demo_type,duration_mins,owner_id,preferred_window
NA,SMB,Live intro,30,sd-101,09:00-11:00 ET
NA,Enterprise,Technical deep-dive,60,sd-201,13:00-17:00 ET
EMEA,SMB,Recorded + scheduler,15,sd-301,09:00-12:00 CET
EMEA,Enterprise,Live deep-dive,60,sd-302,13:00-17:00 CET
APAC,Any,Recorded + calendar,15,sd-401,Weekdays SGT
```

ops-bot: NOTE: Embargo active  DO NOT PUBLISH until 2026-04-08T17:00:00Z. Set metadata `embargo: true` and remove public links from the post until release window. :lock:

cassie: Legal approves the revised footnote. Small edit: change "internal benchmarks" -> "internal performance benchmarks" for consistency across assets.

rob: Copy nit: headline option A: "Predictable LLM inference for production" option B: "Lower-cost inference without sacrificing latency" — I prefer A for clarity.

elena: Leaning A as well. Will lock headline, finalize footnote and demo matrix, then hand off to design & ops. Plan: final review in thread by 5pm PT. If no objections I'll mark ready-for-design and tag @design and @ops. :rocket:
